analyzer-bugs.summary: analyzer resolution differs from Spark: an unused CTE definition over a missing relation is not analyzed, so TABLE_OR_VIEW_NOT_FOUND is not raised (cte#16, cte#24), GROUP BY a backquoted output alias `1`, LIMIT over a column reports UNRESOLVED_COLUMN instead of IS_UNFOLDABLE

datetime.summary: datetime functions and literals beyond P2a (TIMESTAMP literals, date/timestamp arithmetic, patterns, unit-argument forms)

depends-on-command.summary: queries that read a table, view, function or variable an earlier command of the file creates (the command failed, so the query fails or reads the shared fixture of the same name)

files.summary: partitioned and glob reads of directories

fn-aggregate.summary: aggregate and sketch functions beyond P2a, WITHIN GROUP

fn-url-xml-csv.summary: URL, XML, CSV and protobuf functions

generators.summary: generators: explode, LATERAL VIEW, multi-name aliases, stack, inline

nested-interval-types.summary: nested types, intervals, CHAR/VARCHAR, struct constructors, subscripts and field access

output-names.summary: auto-generated column names differ from Spark's toPrettySQL (Java float/decimal text, default arguments, TRIM/CEIL/LOG/mod spellings, +year dates)

parser-tail.summary: TRANSFORM, IDENTIFIER(), TABLE(...) arguments, TABLESAMPLE, NEAREST BY, variant paths

query-features.summary: query features the analyzer or planner lacks: inline VALUES, table-valued functions, NATURAL and USING joins, recursive CTEs, LATERAL, PIVOT/UNPIVOT, OFFSET, GROUP BY ALL, SELECT * EXCEPT, QUALIFY, named and qualified function names, LIKE ANY/ALL, aggregate FILTER, multi-SELECT FROM
